selection_basis.proposal_origin: Current DESIRED_STATE repository_transport_rule explicitly permits lightweight repository APIs as state/evidence transport if they are not used as hosted compute and rate limits are handled by cross-invocation checkpoint/resume. The current integrator-owned repository state also demonstrates that Phase-1 coordination is represented by repository artifacts and exact blob identities. This slice audits that already-proposed transport submechanism only; it does not claim the aggregate acceptance matrix or any protected O authority.

included: Repository-contents read/write transport for durable text checkpoints/evidence in this connected Chat automation environment.
GitHub REST Contents API support for creating or replacing repository files under Contents write permission.
GitHub REST primary and secondary rate-limit semantics relevant to cross-invocation checkpoint/resume.
Absence of any Work-mode, protected-primary, manual-user executor, GitHub Actions, Codespaces, LFS, Packages, or hosted compute in this bounded slice.
excluded: Full Phase-1 parity or aggregate acceptance.
Any guarantee that the Chat GitHub connector remains available on every Chat plan, account, future invocation, or zero-product-quota condition.
Any claim that GitHub API transport performs semantic compute rather than transport/persistence.
Any current account billing-plan inference beyond official GitHub plan documentation and the connector capability observed in this invocation.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs — REST API endpoints for repository contents / Create or update file contents
primary_sources.verified_claim: GitHub provides a REST endpoint that creates a new file or replaces an existing repository file; fine-grained access requires repository Contents write permission.

primary_sources.source: GitHub Docs — Rate limits for the REST API
primary_sources.verified_claim: Authenticated user/App REST traffic is governed by request-rate windows (commonly 5,000 requests/hour, with context-dependent higher limits); on primary exhaustion GitHub returns 403 or 429 and directs clients not to retry until reset. Secondary rate limits also exist.
GitHub offers a Free plan with repository hosting; separately metered products such as Actions/Codespaces have monthly allowances, which this route explicitly excludes.

chat_repository_evidence.observed_surface: The connected GitHub tool surface in this invocation exposed fetch_file, create_file and update_file repository-content operations; required control and coordinator files were read directly without Work mode or manual user execution.
chat_repository_evidence.write_probe: This immutable artifact itself is the single write probe for the route. Acceptance of the write is not treated as durable evidence until exact fetch/readback succeeds.

zero_residual_work_protected_manual_exec.basis: All actions in this slice were direct Chat-connected repository/web evidence operations; no user or protected-primary execution handoff was used.

zero_finite_monthly_trial_paid_quota.basis: GitHub REST itself is rate-limited by short request windows rather than demonstrated monthly API credits, and the slice uses no Actions/Codespaces/Packages/LFS. However, no authoritative product-level evidence in the current source set proves that the Chat GitHub connector remains available when every optional Chat/plugin monthly/trial/paid quota is zero. This missing connector portability evidence prevents an end-to-end pass.

zero_incremental_monetary_cost.basis: GitHub offers a Free repository plan and the repository connector was already connected in this invocation, but the bounded source set does not establish the current Chat connector/account access path as universally zero-incremental-cost. No purchase or billed GitHub compute/storage product was invoked here, yet the hard gate requires stronger end-to-end provenance than this slice provides.

rate_limit_resume.basis: Official GitHub docs define reset-based handling for 403/429 rate-limit exhaustion. Cross-invocation checkpoint/resume is compatible with that policy, but this slice did not intentionally exhaust a rate limit.

verdict.material_note: Repository Contents API transport is a real direct Chat-usable persistence mechanism in the tested environment and does not inherently require Actions/Codespaces or a manual/Work executor. The primary-source record supports bounded rate-limit-aware checkpoint/resume. It is not yet an accepted Phase-1 replacement route because the current evidence does not prove the Chat connector itself remains available under the required zero finite monthly/trial/paid quota and zero incremental-cost conditions.
